summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on FSM1/cipher-box#459 (fix/google-oauth-tauri-redirect branch), which involved a Google OAuth callback port change from dynamic/random ports to fixed ports 14200-14202.
summary.outcome: All 4 unresolved Copilot review threads were triaged, fixed, committed, and resolved. Fixes covered stale JSDoc, a DoS vulnerability in error handling, a TCP packet-splitting bug in the Rust HTTP header parser, and stale debug documentation.

repo: OAuth callback ports are fixed to [14200, 14201, 14202] — no random fallback. If all three are busy, login fails explicitly.
The redirect URI path is /callback, giving full URIs: http://localhost:14200/callback, http://localhost:14201/callback, http://localhost:14202/callback.
Debug/planning docs live under .planning/debug/ and must be kept in sync with code changes.
The project uses pnpm for TypeScript builds/tests and cargo for Rust.

code.finding: JSDoc was stale — still referenced dynamic ports and loopback language after the fixed-port migration.
Error handler rejected the promise before validating the OAuth state parameter, creating a local DoS vector via crafted error payloads. Fix: validate state before handling error.
HTTP header parsing assumed all headers arrived in a single TCP read. Fix: loop-read until \r\n\r\n is present before parsing Content-Length.
Debug doc mentioned a random port fallback that was removed — needed update to reflect fixed-port-only strategy.

workflow: When switching strategies (e.g., dynamic → fixed ports), all doc references — JSDoc, debug docs, planning docs — must be updated in the same PR to avoid stale reviewer comments in follow-up passes.
Copilot does multiple review passes; after pushing fixes it will re-review and may open new threads, requiring another resolve cycle.
The /resolve-pr-reviews skill must be run from the feature branch, not main — running it from main finds no PR and silently stops.

friction: Assistant was on main branch when /resolve-pr-reviews was first invoked, causing it to report no PR and requiring the user to manually redirect to the feature branch.
Two Copilot review passes were required — the second pass opened 4 new threads after the first round of fixes was pushed.
open_items: The three OAuth redirect URIs (http://localhost:14200-14202/callback) must be registered in the Google OAuth Console — user confirmed this was done, but it's an external manual step with no automated verification.
PR #459 was ready for merge at session end but not yet merged.
